notes.title: v0.0.6 Playtest Demo ( ASSIST MODE )
notes.content:
Light Dude is intended to be a [b]challenging [/b]and rewarding experience!

[list]
[*] Replaced the old difficulty system with an Assist Mode inspired by the awesome game Celeste. If you lose more than 10 times in a single level, the Assist mode will unlock for you. Assist Mode allows you to tune the game's rules to fit your needs, such as adjusting the game speed, adding more lights at the start of any level, or increasing the vision range while running.
[*] Fixed the Crystal collection bug
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.5 Playtest Demo
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Difficulty options added. Now you can choose to play on "Easy" difficulty if you just want a more casual experience ( If you are a pro gamer, this Easy mode is not for you :D )
[*] Removed the First-Person mode from the demo temporary since it had lots of glitches and bugs :D However, it will be there in the full game version!
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.2 Playtest Demo
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a heartbeat animation when you are low on lights
[*] Fixed a bug that consumed 1 light when going left/right instantly using keyboard
[*] Boss Fight fixed a bug that made you auto-consume 1 light after hitting the boss
[*] Improved phase transition animation in boss fight such that you get a better glimpse of how the next phase looks like before the level going totally dark 
[/list]
